interpretation: 000 = no connection from this sandbox (DNS/allowlist/proxy refusal), not proof that the host is down.  The DrivenData data tab, the USGS earthquake catalogue, the 3DEP lidar buckets and every open-geoscience repository tested are unreachable; only github.com / api.github.com / codeload.github.com work for code and pypi.org / files.pythonhosted.org for wheels.  Consequence: every layer used by the shipped artifact is derived from the 19 official bands, the competition catalogue and the SGMC raster; hypotheses needing new external data are recorded as DATA-BLOCKED, and no claim of obtainability is made without a code in this file.
